class.name: ResonanceProbeData
class.brief_description: Resource storing baked Steam Audio probe batch data.
class.description: Serialized probe batch (reflections, optional pathing, optional static layers). Assign to [member ResonanceProbeVolume.probe_data]. Written by the bake pipeline; save the scene or resource after baking. Default external paths come from Project Settings (Nexus Resonance Bake output / format). [member baked_reflection_type] must match [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reflection_type] on [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] at runtime (TAN accepts Convolution). When [member baked_ambisonics_order] differs from the order resolved via [url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url] / RuntimeConfig, a warning is printed; playback uses [code]min(baked, realtime)[/code]. Pathing without a pathing layer is skipped; reflections still load.

members.member: Serialized Phonon probe batch bytes. Written by the bake pipeline; do not edit manually.
World-space probe positions stored at bake time for editor visualization.
Hash of volume layout and reflection bake parameters. Compared with [method ResonanceProbeVolume.get_bake_params_hash] for outdated detection.
Hash of pathing bake parameters. 0 when pathing was not baked.
Hash of the static scene used for the last bake. 0 when not recorded.
Hash of static source bake inputs. 0 when no static source layer.
Hash of static listener bake inputs. 0 when no static listener layer.
Baked reverb algorithm: Convolution (0), Parametric (1), Hybrid (2). -1 = legacy (compatible with any runtime type).
HOA order used when baking convolution IRs (1-3). -1 = legacy (treated as 1). Mismatch vs resolved Bake Ambisonic Order warns; playback uses [code]min(baked, realtime)[/code].
